subject: POC trial planning - Aurora Diagnostics (success criteria & RACI)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@auroradx.com>, David Lee <david.lee@auroradx.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0000
Subject: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call - POC plan

Hi Samantha / David —

Thanks for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we draft the mutual action plan: 

Summary of needs
- Objective: Validate Redwood Inference for near-real-time clinical note generation and structured extraction across 3 outpatient clinics.
- Key success criteria: average token latency <= 150ms for 1k token requests, 95th pct latency <= 400ms, end-to-end extraction F1 >= 0.88 on your test set.
- Data flows: On-prem connector to push de-identified transcripts to a dedicated Redwood Private instance in your Azure VNet (we discussed VNet peering / private link).

Proposed POC scope & timeline
- Week 1 (Mar 22-26): Env setup - provisioning Private control plane, network review, security questionnaire.
- Week 2 (Mar 29-Apr 2): Ingest & test harness - load 200 sample documents, run baseline model.
- Weeks 3-4 (Apr 5-Apr 16): Iteration & metrics - optimize prompts, quantization profile; run full 1k doc sweep and collect latency/cost metrics.

Ownership (draft RACI) — please confirm who on your side owns each area:
- Infra/network (VNet, VPN): Aurora IT / networking team
- App integration (connectors, validation): Aurora engineering / product
- Security/compliance (SOC2 evidence, data handling): Aurora security / privacy lead
- Procurement/contract sign-off: Aurora procurement

Action items for Redwood (we'll take these):
- Share draft POC success criteria spreadsheet (attached) and mutual action plan PDF.
- Send security questionnaire for completion.
- Provide checklist for Azure Private deployment.

Attachments: POC_success_criteria.xlsx, Aurora_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf, Security_Questionnaire_Aurora.docx

Can you confirm the owners on your side for the RACI items above and whether the timeline looks OK? Happy to adjust.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

On Thu, 12 Mar 2026 at 14:10, Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@auroradx.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the recap — that aligns with what we covered. I'll loop in David (ops) and procurement.
> 
> Quick Q: For the Private deployment, will Redwood manage the instance or do we provision the VMs and you provide the control plane?
> 
> — Sam
From: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@auroradx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: David Lee <david.lee@auroradx.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 16:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call - POC plan

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary. Confirming: we own infra procurement and will provision the VMs in our Azure subscription; Aurora security will own the questionnaire. I'll introduce procurement separately.

Regarding management: we'd prefer to self-manage the VMs with Redwood providing the private control plane and support (we discussed this on the call). Can you send the exact network requirements and a checklist of ports/peering settings?

Also, can you add a success criterion around cost per 1,000 tokens (ballpark) to compare vs our internal baseline?

Sam

On Thu, 12 Mar 2026 at 15:02, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Yes — we'll send the network checklist and add an estimated cost-per-1k-tokens baseline to the success criteria spreadsheet.
> 
> Marissa
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: POC trial planning - Aurora Diagnostics (internal)

Marissa / Aditya —

Saw Sam's note. A few items to confirm from our side before we send the final MOP: 
- Security questionnaire: we should provide a pre-filled version that highlights standard Redwood controls and call out any Aurora-specific asks. Aditya, can you own the pre-fill and technical appendix for the Private deployment?
- Success criteria: Marissa, please add a "cost per 1k tokens" estimate and also flag the quantization profile we propose (int8-fp16 hybrid).
- RACI: We should propose a single Aurora point of contact for procurement and one for security — draft suggests David Lee for ops and Clara Patel (if procurement@auroradx.com is a team alias, we should still request a named approver).

I'll assemble the mutual action plan PDF once we have those inputs.

Thanks,
Lauren
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:01:00 -0000
Subject: Re: POC trial planning - Aurora Diagnostics (internal)

Lauren / Marissa —

I can own the technical appendix and pre-fill the security questionnaire. I'll include: network port list, expected outbound endpoints, certs/kms integration notes, and a short runbook for initial provisioning. Delivery by Tue EOD (Mar 17).

For the quant profile: I recommend we start with the int8-fp16 hybrid we discussed; it should give ~2x cost savings while keeping latency within your target for 1k tokens. I'll include benchmark numbers from a similar healthcare trial.

Aditya
Software Infrastructure Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@auroradx.com>, David Lee <david.lee@auroradx.com>, procurement@auroradx.com

Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 11:23:00 -0000
Subject: POC plan & RACI — final draft and next steps

Hi Sam / David / procurement team —

Thanks for confirming ownership. Attached are the updated artifacts: Aurora_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf and POC_success_criteria.xlsx (includes the cost-per-1k estimate) and the Security_Questionnaire pre-filled by Aditya. Highlights: 

- RACI (final suggested):
  - Infra/Network: Aurora (David Lee) — R
  - App integration / validation: Aurora (Sam Jones) — A
  - Security/compliance: Aurora (security lead) — C (we asked for a named owner)
  - Redwood: Deployment + tuning + support — A
  - Procurement sign-off: Aurora procurement team — A

- Timeline: Env setup week of Mar 22; tests Mar 29-Apr 2; iteration Apr 5-Apr 16.
- Redwood deliverables: network checklist, security appendix, quantization benchmarks (attached).

Next steps: 
1) Sam, please confirm named security contact and a procurement approver.
2) David / procurement: we'll schedule a 30-min network runthrough once you provision the test VMs.
3) Redwood (Aditya) will deliver the technical appendix by EOD today.

If you're good with the above we'll convert the mutual action plan into a signed MOP and schedule kick-off for Mar 23.

Thanks — looking forward to this POC.

Best,
Marissa
